title: 2025’s Darkest Anime Returns With New Movie This Fall – Watch the Trailer
content: One of the darkest anime of the last year is coming back with a new feature film release later this Fall, and a new trailer is showing more of it off before it hits theaters across Japan.
author: ComicBook

title: The Simpsons Goes Full Nightmare Before Christmas for New Treehouse of Horror Special – Watch
content: The Simpsons is on the cusp of a brand new entry in its annual Treehouse of Horror anthology series this weekend, and to celebrate has dropped the first look at its new makeover inspired by The Nightmare Before Christmas for the occasion.
author: ComicBook

title: Korra Officially Recast With Avatar: Seven Havens Return (New Voice Actor Confirmed)
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has officially reintroduced Korra to the animated series with its newest batch of episodes of Paramount+, and with it has confirmed that a new voice actor has taken over for the role.
author: ComicBook

title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 First Look Confirms More Returning Character Makeovers
content: Delicious in Dungeon is now in the works on Season 2 of the anime , and the anime has dropped the first look at more of the returning characters fans will see in action with the new episodes.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Hypes Jump Festa With Cool New Look
content: 2026 is one of the most exciting years for Dragon Ball fans, as the year kicked off with several exciting announcements. Dragon Ball originally concluded its manga serialization in 1995, which is why its return two decades later was the most exciting surprise for fans.
author: ComicBook

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Movie Trailer Shows Off Best Look Yet – Watch Now
content: The Apothecary Diaries is coming to the big screen later this year, and a new trailer for its feature film debut is really showing off the best look yet at what fans can hope to see.
author: ComicBook

title: Kaiju No. 8 Anime to End With Final Movie in 2027 – Watch First Look Teaser
content: Kaiju No. 8 is gearing up for its grand finale, and the anime has dropped the first look teaser for its new movie coming to theaters across Japan next year. Naoya Matsumoto’s Kaiju No. 8 has been one of Shueisha’s biggest breakout successes of the last few years.
author: ComicBook

title: Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Most Ambitious Seinen Anime Has Bad News for Season 3
content: Attack on Titan and Jujutsu Kaisen are among the greatest anime out there, partly thanks to how they were brought to life by MAPPA . The studio took over production of Attack on Titan starting with its final season, and despite fans’ doubts, the anime emerged as one of the best.
author: ComicBook

title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess Cour 2 Reveals Teaser Trailer Ahead of January 2027 Debut
content: Though I Am an Inept Villainess: Tale of the Butterfly-Rat Body Swap in the Maiden Court has released a teaser trailer for its second cour, which will begin airing in January 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kaiju No. 8 Final Movie Announced for 2027 as Anime Conclusion
content: Kaiju No. 8: The Movie will officially conclude with the series as a theatrical film set for release in 2027, bringing the anime series to its final chapter on the big screen. The movie will follow the first two seasons of the TV anime and serve as the conclusion to the entire adaptation.
author: Anime Corner
